purpose: Establish the ROCIT member's byte identity, and re-establish the three IGS decoded outputs, by two independent methods each. On success this report becomes the FIFTH immutable oracle source and the member's evidence_state moves opaque -> resolvable.
framing_correction: This is AUTHENTICATION AND REPRODUCTION of a prior observation, not a prospective prediction: the claimed member values were supplied before registration. A confirmation here carries the evidential weight of an independent reproduction, not of a successful blind prediction.
generator: phase2/wp2a/run_step2.py (frozen before execution; not yet written)

trusted_base.note: unixz.py was verified byte-identical to gzip -dc in Phase 0. Step 2 does NOT inherit that: each decode is cross-checked against an independent implementation here.

unix_compress.note: v1.1 named no Unix-compress target population at all.

digest_form.note: The registration carried only 60 of 256 bits (8-char prefix + 7-char suffix).

outcome_rules.when: both methods executed, agreed with each other, and matched the expected digest
both methods executed and agreed with each other, but differed from the expected digest
outcome_rules.note: The claimed value is refuted. A typed, reportable result -- the trial halts and says so.

outcome_rules.when: both methods executed but DISAGREED WITH EACH OTHER
outcome_rules.note: ADDED IN v1.2. v1.1 had no outcome for this and would have had to pick a winner. Two extractors disagreeing means neither reading is trustworthy; no digest may be adopted.

outcome_rules.when: a method did not run, or produced no output

run_outcome_rules.consequence: report becomes the fifth oracle source; member evidence_state opaque -> resolvable
trial halts; the refuted claim is reported as a finding about the evidence
trial halts; NO digest is adopted from a disagreeing pair
trial halts; step 2 is re-run, never partially adopted

immutability: On step2_supports the report is pinned by digest into contract v1.2 §4 as source five and never regenerated. A later re-run produces a NEW report; it does not overwrite this one.
